content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early-to-mid forecast horizon, especially after sharp price spikes.
- Overestimates in late forecast period (last 5–10 days) when prices are trending upward or recovering.
- Shows persistent lag in capturing recent price reversals; often misses downward momentum by 1–3 days.
- Tends to overshoot after sharp upward moves, then fails to correct downward quickly.
- Mean reversion bias: forecasts too aggressively revert to historical mean, ignoring recent volatility or structural shifts.
- Underestimates volatility in low-price regimes; overestimates in high-price regimes.
- Horizon-specific: 1–3 day lag in capturing short-term price momentum; 5–10 day overcorrection in medium-term forecasts.
